parent.intent: Fork the baseline once and host sub-agents on that same repo.

subs.intent: Add the API handler without touching the UI.
subs.command: mkdir -p src/api && printf '%s\n' 'export function handler() { return "api"; }' > src/api/handler.js

subs.intent: Add the UI view without touching the API.
subs.command: mkdir -p src/ui && printf '%s\n' 'export function view() { return "ui"; }' > src/ui/view.js
